meta.title: Quality & capabilities | ISO 9001, G7, lab — Saladín Industria Gráfica
meta.description: ISO 9001:2015 management system since 2014, in-house G7 color management, in-house structural design, testing laboratory and a Business Continuity Plan. This is how we guarantee every run.

hero.title: The only way to produce the best is to use the best
hero.subtitle: Quality here is not a slogan: it's a certified, measured system installed at every stage — from dieline to delivery.

sections.title: ISO 9001:2015 since 2014
sections.text: Our quality management system has been certified since 2014. Documented, audited, continuously improving processes across all three plants.

sections.title: In-house G7 color management
sections.text: We calibrate and control color with G7 methodology in-house. Your Pantone looks the same on the first run and on run number fifty.

sections.title: In-house structural design and development
sections.text: Our own packaging engineering: dielines, prototypes and custom structures matched to the product, the filling line and the client's logistics.

sections.title: Testing laboratory
sections.text: We verify materials and finished packaging in our own laboratory before they reach your line.

sections.title: Business Continuity Plan (BCP)
sections.text: Your supply chain doesn't stop: we maintain a formal BCP to keep serving you through contingencies.

sections.title: 3 plants + warehouse · 97,000 ft²
sections.text: Real installed capacity: three production plants plus warehouse, with 120 employees, between Herrera and the Las Américas Free Trade Zone.

sections.title: FSC certification in progress (2026)
sections.text: We are in the FSC certification process, expected for 2026: verified chain of custody for paper and board, for brands that export.

cta.title: We put this system to work for your brand
